identity_note: The datasheet instruction set defines no ID register and no read of identity, so a chip that acknowledges the address cannot be told apart from a BH1750. Only the acknowledgement and the plausibility of a reading can be checked.
bounds_citation: Rohm BH1750FVI datasheet (2009.04 Rev.B) p.1: "Wide range and High resolution. ( 1 - 65535 lx )"; p.2: dark (0 lx) sensor output 0 to 3 counts, so 0 lx is a valid reading

adapter.driver: Direct Wire driver written from the datasheet. The claws/BH1750 1.3.0 library prints [BH1750] ERROR lines to Serial on failure, which the documented serial grammar does not allow.

facts.fact: Slave address 0100011 (0x23) when ADDR is low, 1011100 (0x5C) when ADDR is high

Instruction set: 0x00 power down, 0x01 power on, 0x07 reset (data register only, not accepted in power down), 0x10 continuous H-resolution, 0x11 continuous H-resolution mode 2, 0x13 continuous L-resolution, 0x20 0x21 0x23 one-time variants
Initial state is power down; the power-on command may be omitted before a measurement command
H-resolution measurement time 120 ms typical, 180 ms maximum; L-resolution 16 ms typical, 24 ms maximum
Dark (0 lx) sensor output is 0 to 3 counts in H-resolution mode
Result is a 16-bit value, high byte first, divided by 1.2 to give lx (typical sensor out / actual lx is 1.2, range 0.96 to 1.44)

software_choices: Serial and display formats, the fixture reading and the 65535 lx plausibility ceiling are software choices taken from the stated range, not measurements.
